messages:
maria: Heads up — argocd prune waves started failing in us-west-2 ~10m ago. Several GPU node pools stuck in Terminating. Seeing a flood of 429s from the controller. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: on it, I'm tailing argocd-application-controller and repo-server logs now.
sre-tom: we've hit similar symptoms when app-of-apps fans out too many syncs — Git provider rate limits + controller backoff. How big is the fanout?
maria: app-of-apps is managing ~480 apps. appset configured with batchSize=50 and parallelism=20. Controller logs show repeated: 
```
time="2026-03-18T14:10:02Z" level=error msg="prune failed" application=gpu-pools err="Request failed: 429 Too Many Requests
    at provider.go:123"
```
jen: can you dump a couple more lines around the error? and which host is being rate limited (git vs cloud api)?
kevin: logs point to git provider (github enterprise) 429s on clone/commit operations, not AWS. The sequence: many apps try to prune/update, repo-server spawns lots of clones -> 429 from git host -> controller backoff -> prune wave stalls.
maria: we tried bumping appset batchSize to 100 earlier and it made things worse (more parallel clones). Rolling back to 50 didn't clear the backlog.
sre-tom: workaround options: 1) throttle appset fanout (smaller batches), 2) enable repo-server cache/replica to reduce clones, 3) add an exponential backoff on appset controller, 4) ask git provider for higher rate limits for CI user.
jen: also consider disabling prune for non-critical apps during recovery: set `spec.syncOptions: [ \"Prune=false\" ]` on appsets temporarily. That buys time while we clear node Terminating churn.
kevin: I'm going to patch the app-of-apps Helm values to shrink batchSize -> 10 and add a 2s inter-item delay using the appset `template`. Applying now.
ops-bot: incident-bot created alert: `argocd-prune-failure-high-rate` (severity: page) — notifying oncall.
maria: another datapoint — GPU pools stuck in Terminating because finalizers wait for cloud resources that the cluster-gc job is trying to delete while argocd keeps trying to reapply manifests. It's a churn loop.
sre-tom: temporary plan: pause apps that manage node pools, shrink fanout to 10, enable Prune=false on low-priority apps, and scale repo-server to 3 replicas. I'll open a PR with the steps.
kevin: patch applied: `values.appset.batchSize=10`, `values.appset.interDelaySeconds=2`. Rolling upgrade of app-of-apps chart in 30s.
maria: patch in, starting to see fewer clone attempts. GPU pools moving out of Terminating -> resources deleted -> new nodes coming up.
jen: follow-up: we should add repo-server horizontal scaling to the playbook and request a higher API quota from GH enterprise; also add per-app jitter to avoid synchronized retries.
argocd-bot: Application gpu-node-pool: sync succeeded (prune completed) — revision: abc123 — duration: 1m12s
maria: status looks stable so far. Leaving guards on for the next 2h, will revert Prune=false after we confirm. Thanks all :thumbsup:
